maya: Quick nsys snapshot from main @everyone — batch=16, seq=1024, node: 1xA100. total GPU time ~2.3s. Top suspects by cumulative GPU time: fmha_fp16_fwd (~45%), kv_cache_lookup (~18%), gemm_lt_s1688 (~10%), layer_norm_fwd (~8%), cudaMemcpyAsync (~6%). nvtx trace uploaded to the run.

jason: can you paste the top-k table so we can triage? :eyes:

maya: sure — pasted below from nsys summary:
```
nsys top kernels (gpu_time, cumulative):
1  fmha_fp16_fwd         1.04s   45.2%
2  kv_cache_lookup       0.41s   18.0%
3  gemm_lt_s1688         0.23s   10.0%
4  layer_norm_fwd        0.18s    7.8%
5  cudaMemcpyAsync       0.14s    6.1%
others (kernels <3% each)
```

liam: for kv_cache_lookup do we have occupancy/SM-util? sounds like memory-bound to me.

maya: occupancy ~32%, SM util ~55% for kv_cache_lookup. perf counters show L2 hit ~22%, DRAM BW high — pattern looks like scattered loads (uncoalesced). Prefetching might help.

chris: was this run before the prefetch patch landed in the branch?

maya: yes — this was pre-prefetch. I'll re-run with prefetch=16 and a config that forces coalesced lookups.

perf-bot: New run queued -> job_id:8743, args: prefetch=16,batch=16, seq=1024, run_ts=2761112288

jason: note that if kv_lookup time drops we risk moving the hotspot back to fmha. we should also look at batch size distribution — are we getting a lot of tiny microbatches from the grpc scheduler?

maya: batch histogram shows many microbatches (1-2 tokens) due to grpc flush behavior. I'll capture the batching trace and upload. Also gemm_lt_s1688 looks like a suboptimal algo selection for short sequence tails.

liam: +1 on sequence-length routing. gemm_lt picks algo with low occupancy for short seqs; propose seq-aware kernel routing (canary config) and a fallback to fused GEMM for tails.

maya: will open a follow-up PR for seq-routing + prefetch canary. For now I'll attach the new run results to the kernel-ranking dashboard and follow up with a short perf note. :thumbsup:
note: thread contains nsys summary, perf counters, and planned re-run with prefetch; follow-ups expected
